The '''Citadel Challenge''' was a training program on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] used to train the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:Arcbricscrubber.png|thumb|left|220px|[[Colt/Legends|Commander Colt]], [[El-Les/Legends|El-Les]], and [[Bric/Legends|Bric]] overseeing the final training test.]]
The complex itself consisted of simulated battlefields. Through the use of adjustable [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] floor plates and atmosphere generators, the complex could easily replicate a variety of environments and terrains. It was also able to create crude stadiums for the demonstration of combat skills.<ref name="CC">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref> The challenge was named after the deadly [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]], the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]].<ref name="cr">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode320.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Citadel Rescue}}</ref>

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA-2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Jedi General [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] was sent to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to oversee the training of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troopers. The Citadel Challenge was created to test clone [[Clone cadet/Legends|cadet]] [[Squad/Legends|squads]] to see whether or not the clones were ready to be sent into battle.<ref name="CC" />

Some squads, such as [[Bravo Squad (clone cadets)/Legends|Bravo Squad]], excelled at the challenge. But others, such as [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]], were not as fortunate. Being unable to function together as a team, the squad would continue to fail the training assignment. But after overcoming each other's differences, the members of Domino Squad were able to overcome the Citadel Challenge and pass their final test.<ref name="CC" />
